overview:
Atheneum is a global insights platform founded in 2010 in Berlin, Germany. Company sources identify Mathias Wengeler and Ammad Ahmad as co-founders; its 2021 funding announcement also names Marta Margolis in the founding management team. The company operates as a Research-as-a-Service (RaaS) provider, connecting investment funds, strategy consulting firms, and corporations with industry experts. Its current website reports nine offices worldwide and 60+ languages spoken.

Atheneum offers expert calls, surveys, expert-backed research, and placements, supported by its client-facing Atheneum Insights Platform and Atheneum Hub app for experts. A December 2020 announcement describes cooperation with Nikkei Inc.’s NIKKEI SEEKS platform to improve Japanese expert sourcing; the 500,000+ figure in that announcement refers to Atheneum’s international network, not a Japanese expert pool. In August 2021, Atheneum announced $150 million in growth funding led by Guidepost Growth Equity and reported more than 500 enterprise customers at that time.

Recent developments include expert terms updated in April 2026 that permit AI-enabled recording, transcription, summaries, and analysis, while prohibiting experts from using AI to generate answers. As checked on November 11, 2026, Atheneum’s leadership page lists Dan McCarthy as CEO and David Koscinski as CTO.

history.narrative: Atheneum launched in Berlin in 2010. Company sources name Mathias Wengeler and Ammad Ahmad as co-founders and describe their management consulting background. The company announced €10 million in funding led by Crosslantic Capital Management in September 2018, followed by $150 million led by Guidepost Growth Equity in August 2021. Jim Owens succeeded Wengeler as CEO in April 2023.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Calls
servicesDetailed.description: One-on-one consultations with pre-screened industry experts. Atheneum says it provides a preliminary shortlist within 60 minutes, or within 30 minutes for established clients. Its website reports 60+ languages spoken across the business; this is not a guarantee of interpretation for every engagement.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Quantitative research through custom-recruited expert panels. Atheneum advertises deployment within 24 hours, with support for design, programming, translation, recruitment, analysis, and reporting. It offers full-service and sample-only support.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert-Backed Research
servicesDetailed.description: Full-service custom research leveraging Atheneum’s in-house team to moderate interviews and produce white-label reports. Includes voice-of-customer studies, model assessments, and target screenings. Its services page also lists automated transcripts and searchable audio recordings.

servicesDetailed.name: In-Person Meetings & Workshops
servicesDetailed.description: Facilitated face-to-face engagements connecting clients directly with subject matter experts for qualitative research and strategic insight sessions. The service offering also includes expert webinars.

servicesDetailed.name: Long-Term Expert Placements
servicesDetailed.description: Expert recruitment for short-, medium-, and long-term engagements, including workshops, on-site visits, focus groups, and advisory panels.

servicesDetailed.name: NIKKEI SEEKS (2020 collaboration)
servicesDetailed.description: Atheneum announced cooperation with Nikkei Inc.’s Japanese expert search platform in December 2020. The announcement describes combining Japanese expert sourcing with Atheneum’s international network of more than 500,000 experts at that time; it does not establish a 500,000-person Japan-based pool or exclusive access.

aiPlatform.narrative: Atheneum’s August 2021 funding announcement described proprietary machine learning software and the cloud-based Athena One platform. Its current digital products page describes the Atheneum Insights Platform for client project management and the Atheneum Hub app for expert opportunities, schedules, messaging, and payments. Atheneum says experts complete the application process 33% faster through Hub than online; the reviewed page provides no methodology. The April 2026 expert terms permit AI-enabled recording, transcription, summaries, and analytical outputs, as well as use of engagement content to develop and improve systems. These contractual permissions do not establish a specific named AI product or its performance.

complianceExtended.narrative: Atheneum’s published privacy policy sets out a Group Data Protection Officer reporting to the COO, a Privacy Chief, data minimization and retention principles, international transfer safeguards, and breach response procedures. These are published company policies, not independent certification of compliance. Its April 2026 expert terms prohibit MNPI disclosure and conflicts of interest, require employer permissions where applicable, and allow identity checks, compliance monitoring, and project participation records. The terms allow expert names and professional backgrounds to be shared with clients and their end-clients for consultation evaluation.
